messages:
raj: kicking off a config-only change in the overnight change window (02:00-04:00 UTC). changes: reduce global concurrent cap for route X, tighten request timeout, adjust batching/token cap for low-latency tenants. Canary plan: 0.5% -> 3% -> 15%. will pin canary to model tag canary-2026-01. @deploy-bot start job when ready and attach PR #4721.

deploy-bot: @raj scheduled config rollout window 02:00-04:00 UTC. Canary schedule: 0.5% for 12m, 3% for 18m, 15% for 25m. Job id cc-9072. Auto-fallback: restore previous config and flush per-host queue_shim on manual rollback.

ana: Quick reminder: this touches routeX rate_limit and batching.max_tokens, which can affect long-sequence customers. Add long-seq smoke. Also suggest temporary soft-fallback policy: routeX.fallback=reduce_weight_then_queue.

raj: adding fallback and long-seq smoke. config patch pushed to PR #4721 (snippet below).

```
routeX.concurrent_max=180
routeX.fallback_policy=reduce_weight_then_queue
request.timeout_ms=12000
batching.max_tokens=768
pinning.model=canary-2026-01
queue_shim.soft_cap=0.65
```

infra-bot: Preflight checks: lint OK, schema OK, no conflicting pins detected. Canary slice reserved (hosts: 67 for 0.5%).

oncall-tom: Guardrails I'll watch and action: p99 token latency spike >250ms sustained 4m OR client 5xx delta >0.4% rolling 10m -> rollback. Also monitor batching.qdepth and kvcache.thrashing. If any host reports >1 OOM in 20m during canary, unwind.

raj: applying 0.5% canary now. will post logs and first smoke runs here.

deploy-bot: cc-9072: applying to 67 hosts (0.5%). logs:

[02:01:03] cc-9072: push start -> 67 hosts
[02:01:10] cc-9072: config write ok
[02:01:15] cc-9072: routeX.concurrent_max=180 applied
[02:01:21] cc-9072: batching.max_tokens=768 applied
[02:02:45] cc-9072: queue_shim.soft_cap=0.65 applied

infra-bot: Healthcheck: initial 4m checks passed. perf delta: p50 +6ms, p95 +18ms, p99 +28ms. No increase in 5xx.

ana: starting long-seq smoke (>=1500 tokens) across a few tenants to catch kv warming issues.

infra-bot: Smoke result: 6/6 passes. p99 long-seq +60ms vs baseline (within expected). No OOMs.

raj: green for 3% ramp in 10m. reminder: we will monitor tenant-specific error rates closely; enable tenant-level excludes if we see regressions.

oncall-tom: noted. if p99 >250ms for >4m during 3% ramp, I will trigger rollback steps: 1) revert cc-9072 on control plane, 2) flush queue_shim on canary hosts, 3) unpin model, 4) run quick-cooldown to prevent flapping.

deploy-bot: scheduling 3% ramp in 10m.

raj: small extra precaution: set a temporary traffic cap per-tenant of 20rps for routeX during canary to protect low-volume tenants. applied as part of canary config.

infra-bot: 3% ramp applied at 02:25 UTC -> 402 hosts. quick checks: p99 +35ms, client errors steady.

ana: running another round of long-seq and memory pressure checks. please call out any GPU mem >85% for >5m.

infra-bot: long-seq smoke: 0 failures after 9 runs. memory: one host hit 87% GPU mem transient for 4m, no OOMs.

oncall-tom: that transient is okay but keep watching. if it hits 90% for >3m I revert.

raj: moving to 15% ramp in 20m if green. will keep canary pinned for at least 45m after full ramp. plan to merge PR #4721 with release notes if no issues. thanks all for coverage. :thumbsup:
